data.text: Parcel is a web application bundler that requires zero configuration. It automatically detects entry points, transpiles code, and optimizes bundles. It supports JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, images, and more out of the box.

data.title: Zero-Config Build
data.content: Bundle a project with no configuration needed.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Built-in support for many file types
data.takeaway: Parcel is ideal for quick project setup without build configuration overhead.
